__comment: Shared byte-for-byte corpus for vegan verdict tests in veganAndroid and veganIOS. Any change must be applied identically in both repositories.

cases.rationale: A structured Open Food Facts ingredient marked no must identify cochineal/E120 as the confirmed cause.
Natural aroma is not enough evidence for an animal origin and should remain orientative.
A structured lactose ingredient marked no is a confirmed animal-origin cause.
Milk powder in free text is detected heuristically and must be presented as orientative.
A may-contain trace warning is cross-contamination guidance, not a confirmed ingredient.
cases.ingredientsText: Wheat flour, sugar. May contain traces of milk.

cases.rationale: Vitamin D3 marked maybe is a doubtful structured ingredient.
Mono and diglycerides marked maybe must remain doubtful rather than being treated as certainly animal.
Gelatin marked no is a confirmed animal-origin ingredient.
Rennet marked no is a confirmed animal-origin ingredient.
Beeswax in free text is detected by the animal-ingredient heuristic.
A vegan seal may resolve an otherwise unknown product.
A meat-substitute category may resolve an otherwise unknown product.
A vegan seal plus a structured ingredient marked no is a conflict: report it as doubtful and name the suspicious ingredient.
Normalization must handle uppercase text, accents, language prefixes, underscores and HTML.
Spanish animal terminology must be detected from free text.
English animal terminology must be detected from free text.
Markup must be removed before heuristic segmentation so evidence contains no tag residue.
A Portuguese ingredient without a shared animal marker must not be guessed as animal.
Italian animal terminology must be detected from free text.
French animal terminology must be detected from free text.
German animal terminology must be detected from free text.
A decisive non-vegan analysis tag with no vegan seal must still be reported as not vegan.
An animal-origin additive reported by Open Food Facts must make the product not vegan and report its code.
Gelatine reported as E428 must make the product not vegan.
An uncertain-origin additive must remain doubtful rather than causing a false negative.
An animal-origin additive code in the ingredient text must be detected without an additives tag.
A structured vegan product with a plant-origin additive remains vegan without a culprit.
The decisive vegan tag takes precedence over an uncertain-origin additive.
An animal-origin additive overrides a derived vegan tag and reports its code.
An animal-origin additive present only in the extended catalog must make the product not vegan.
An uncertain-origin additive present only in the extended catalog must remain doubtful.
The vegan seal registered in the database is checked first: a non-vegan analysis tag with no identifiable animal ingredient must not override it.
cases.ingredientsText: Harina de trigo, azúcar. Puede contener trazas de leche.

cases.rationale: Milk present only in a may-contain warning is cross-contamination, so the product is suitable even without a vegan seal.
cases.ingredientsText: Harina de trigo, azúcar. Puede contener trazas de leche.

cases.rationale: Egg present only in a may-contain warning must not condemn the product.
cases.ingredientsText: Harina, azúcar. Puede contener trazas de huevo.

cases.rationale: Milk listed as a real ingredient still condemns the product, and the named ingredient must be the milk, not the egg trace warning.
cases.ingredientsText: Leche desnatada, azúcar. Puede contener trazas de huevo.

cases.rationale: An animal sub-ingredient nested inside a compound ingredient must be identified by name instead of an unnamed verdict.
cases.ingredientsText: Cobertura de chocolate (azúcar, manteca de cacao, leche en polvo), harina

cases.rationale: A non-vegan analysis tag with no corroborating animal ingredient must downgrade to doubtful and name the suspicious ingredient.
An animal ingredient named in another language than the ingredient text must not be mistaken for a trace just because the may-contain warning mentions an animal.
cases.ingredientsText: Suero de leche, azúcar. Puede contener trazas de huevo.

cases.rationale: A non-vegan analysis tag must not condemn a product whose ingredient list contains nothing animal.
cases.ingredientsText: Harina de trigo, azúcar, aceite de girasol.

cases.rationale: With no ingredient data to verify against, the non-vegan analysis tag is all we have and must still condemn.
A non-vegan analysis tag corroborated by an animal ingredient in free text must condemn and name that ingredient.
